thread:
raj: Heads up — seeing a recurring soft ECC pattern on 4 cards across eu-west-2 rack 3, started ~02:10 UTC. Errors spike after ~20–30m burst then drop. Xid 13 observed on two nodes. Could be thermal or intermittent card failure. Need triage -> replacement path. :wave:

ops-bot: [ALERT] gpu-diagnostics: ECC rate >= 0.5% across 4 GPUs in cluster eu-west-2-3. Auto-drain initiated for nodes gpu-node-23, gpu-node-47.

alana: on it. can you paste the `nvidia-smi -q` snippet and last 200 lines of dmesg from the affected hosts? also which scheduled jobs were on those nodes — want to check if this aligns with long-running batches.

mira: echoing alana. quick checks: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=temperature.gpu,utilization.gpu,fan.speed --format=csv -i 0` and `sensors` on the host. if temps >85C consistently, treat as thermal. otherwise collect ECC histograms and ioctl traces.

raj: logs pasted below + serials. dmesg shows repeated: 
[  3421.412345] NVRM: Xid (0001:13): PID 1234: Graphics Exception on channel 0x0001
[  3421.412678] NVRM: GPU at 0000:65:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[  3423.418234] NVRM: RmInitAdapter failed for GPU 0000:65:00.0 - (0x19:0xffff:121)

nvidia-smi --query-gpu=ecc.errors.volatile,ecc.errors.aggregate --format=csv
gpu 0, volatile: 24, aggregate: 120
gpu 1, volatile: 1, aggregate: 2

raj: Serial list: SN-AB12345, SN-AB12346, SN-CD99871, SN-CD99872 (these map to gpu-node-23: SN-AB12345/46, gpu-node-47: SN-CD99871/72).

sophie: vendor-contact here. thanks for the details. next step from our side: vendor needs serials + ECC histograms + recent S.M.A.R.T snapshot and logs. ETA for standard RMA queue EU -> 4 business days; expedited shipping + priority code can cut to 24–48h. please include runbook notes for onsite swaps if requested. :+1:

josh: capacity note — prefer staggered single-card swaps across racks to avoid large throughput drops. we should reserve 2 spare nodes in eu-west-2 and move critical pods before any drain window. also avoid swapping during nightly heavy retrain windows (US evening).

alana: proposed plan:
1) Confirm not power/thermal: collect sensors + PDUs logs (2 hours).
2) Attach logs and open vendor ticket with serials (I will draft ticket).
3) Schedule swaps in a 3-hour maintenance window, staggered per-rack (swap one card per rack per hour).
4) Mark nodes drained in scheduler and route jobs to reserved spares.

alana: creating ticket template now and will attach logs. will tag support:vendor/sophieware and ops-oncall.

raj: runbook snippet for techs and ticket body below:
```
# Drain node and collect artifacts
kubectl drain gpu-node-23 --ignore-daemonsets --force --delete-local-data
ssh gpu-node-23 'sudo dmesg | tail -n 300 > /tmp/dmesg.err; nvidia-smi --query-gpu=ecc.errors.volatile,ecc.errors.aggregate,temperature.gpu --format=csv > /tmp/gpu_ecc.csv'
# RMA ticket body (paste below):
Vendor: Sophieware
Serials: SN-AB12345, SN-AB12346
Cluster: eu-west-2
Symptoms: recurring soft ECC, Xid 13, GPU fell off bus
Attachments: /tmp/dmesg.err, /tmp/gpu_ecc.csv, SMART snapshot
```

mira: bumped monitoring alert to critical and added regression tag. will schedule extended memtest on the two affected cards during the drain window; if memtest fails we escalate to full RMA.

ops-bot: [ACTION] rma-ticket-created: TICKET-4521 by alana assigned vendor/sophieware. Tracking serials: SN-AB12345, SN-CD99871.

raj: ack — I'll coordinate the spare reservations and confirm the maintenance window for tomorrow 02:00–05:00 UTC. will post updates here after sensor checks. :thumbsup:
